title: Feedable Sheep
description: Makes you be able to feed sheep grass to regrow it's wool immediately
body:
### Feature
This is a super simple plugin with a single feature.
You can feed a sheared sheep with these items
- Short grass
- Tall grass
- Grass block
It will consume the item (if a grass block, it will give you a dirt block) and the sheep's wool will be back. Comes with a sound effect and particles :)
